body:
Include analyzers (include-what-you-use, clang-tidy's `misc-include-cleaner`) told code that includes only `<nlohmann/json.hpp>` to also include internal headers, because `json.hpp` did not mark them as exported. Worst case, the suggested fix replaced `json.hpp` with `json_fwd.hpp` and the code stopped compiling (#5812).

### Changes

- `include/nlohmann/json.hpp`: `// IWYU pragma: export` on the includes whose names client code uses:

  | Header | Client use |
  |---|---|
  | `json_fwd.hpp` | `nlohmann::json`, `ordered_json` (#5812) |
  | `detail/json_ref.hpp` | brace initialization (IWYU only) |
  | `json_literals.hpp` | `_json`, `_json_pointer` |
  | `adl_serializer.hpp` | `adl_serializer` specializations (was `keep`) |
  | `detail/macro_scope.hpp` | `NLOHMANN_DEFINE_*` macros |
  | `detail/abi_macros.hpp` | `NLOHMANN_JSON_NAMESPACE_*` macros |

- **CI:** `ci_single_binaries` only checked each header on its own, so it could not catch this. It now also builds three small client programs in `tests/iwyu_consumer/` and runs IWYU (`iwyu_tool --error`) and `clang-tidy --checks=-*,misc-include-cleaner --warnings-as-errors=*` on them.
- With the exports, IWYU no longer gives `json_literals.hpp` the "use json_fwd.hpp" suggestion that kept it out of the IWYU gate, so it is gated again.
- `single_include` is re-amalgamated. The amalgamated `json.hpp` contains `json_fwd.hpp` itself, so single-header users were not affected. It only gains pragma comment lines.

### Verification

I ran `ci_single_binaries` in the CI image (`silkeh/clang:22`, IWYU 0.23, clang-tidy 22):

- **This branch:** passes.
- **With develop's `json.hpp`:** fails. Both IWYU and include-cleaner flag all three client files, and IWYU also flags `json_literals.hpp`.

I also ran clang-tidy 23 on the reproducer from the issue: clean with this change, two findings on develop.

`NLOHMANN_JSON_SERIALIZE_ENUM` is not covered by the client programs. IWYU attributes the `basic_json` comparison inside its expansion to `<map>`, the same ambiguity that keeps `json.hpp` itself out of the gate. Its header is still covered by `NLOHMANN_DEFINE_TYPE_INTRUSIVE`.

Fixes #5812

## Public API

No breaking changes. Only comment pragmas are added to the public headers.

linked_issues.body:
### Description

`nlohmann/json.hpp` includes `nlohmann/json_fwd.hpp`, which is the only header that declares the `nlohmann::json` alias (`using json = basic_json<>;`), but the include is not marked as exported. Include analysers that follow the IWYU model, such as clang-tidy's `misc-include-cleaner` and include-what-you-use, therefore attribute the `nlohmann::json` name to `json_fwd.hpp` and the class members to `json.hpp`.

As a result:

- Any source that names `nlohmann::json` and uses it is told to include **both** headers, although `json.hpp` already provides everything `json_fwd.hpp` declares.
- A source whose only uses are implicit (for example brace-initialising a `json` value) is told that `json_fwd.hpp` is sufficient. Applying the suggested fix replaces `json.hpp` with `json_fwd.hpp` and the code stops compiling with "implicit instantiation of undefined template `nlohmann::basic_json<>`".

### Reproduction

```cpp
#include <nlohmann/json.hpp>

auto Make() -> nlohmann::json { return { { "a", 1 } }; }
```

`clang-tidy --checks=-*,misc-include-cleaner` reports that no header providing `nlohmann::json` is directly included and suggests adding `<nlohmann/json_fwd.hpp>`.

### Suggested fix

Mark the include in `json.hpp` (and the amalgamated single header's equivalent) as exported:

```cpp
#include <nlohmann/json_fwd.hpp> // IWYU pragma: export
```

Both clang-tidy's include-cleaner and include-what-you-use honour this pragma, so users would only need `json.hpp` in sources and could keep `json_fwd.hpp` for headers that only need the declaration.

### Version

3.11.3, observed with clang-tidy 23 (`misc-include-cleaner`).

### Workaround

Add `nlohmann/json_fwd\.hpp` to `misc-include-cleaner.IgnoreHeaders`.
linked_issues.title: Mark json_fwd.hpp as exported by json.hpp for include-what-you-use / clang-tidy misc-include-cleaner

title: Export client-facing headers from json.hpp for IWYU / include-cleaner, and check clients in CI
